## Outcome

Describe the observable user/developer result, not only the implementation idea.

## Issue metadata (required for triage)

- Kind / native GitHub issue type: Task (verify native setting)
- Labels: workstream / priority / maturity (apply existing approved labels)
- Assignee: @yigit-denktas
- GitHub Project: Kushluk (pending creation/configuration: #62)
- Project fields: Stage / Priority / Workstream / Maturity / Evidence
- Milestone: existing outcome milestone or TBD (do not invent)
- Relationships: parent / children / blocks / blocked by
- Development branch / linked PR: pending until work begins

## Linked planning

- Master ledger: #43
- Parent / owner epic:
- Work-ledger task IDs:
- Accepted ADR constraints:

## Scope / exclusions

State what will be changed, and which larger refactors or services are out of scope.

## Acceptance evidence

- [ ] Reproducible success test:
- [ ] Failure / privacy / permission test:
- [ ] User-visible artifact or fixture:
- [ ] Documentation/status update after real verification:

## Dependencies and risks

Include third-party rights, providers, tokens, printed output and needed physical hardware.

## Decision status

Proposed work is **not** delivered merely because this issue is open or a PR exists.
